page.layout: One blank board: a blind-stamped ornamental cartouche (oval medallion within scrolls) in the centre, inside a blind-ruled frame. No printed text.
page.notes: Scan of the outer cover (binding board), not a printed page. Shows a blind-tooled (embossed) ornament: a central oval panel framed by scrolls and volutes, with a double-ruled border.
